{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers (all rows where converted == 1)
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Count how many have valid age (not -1)
valid_age_count = (converted_df['customer_age'] != -1).sum()
invalid_age_count = len(converted_df) - valid_age_count

# Compute mean age on valid ages only
mean_age = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Number of converted customers: {len(converted_df)}')
print(f'Number with valid age: {valid_age_count}')
print(f'Number with age -1: {invalid_age_count}')
print(f'Mean age of converted customers (valid ages only): {mean_age:.2f}')"}
